dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the anterior-lateral region are defined by irregular high-intensity (bright) perimeters enclosing lower-intensity (dark) cores, creating a high-contrast boundary against the darker base pelt.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated clusters of high-intensity pixel blobs are localized in the anterior-dorsal and lower-anterior regions, presenting as solid points with high spatial density and minimal internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent annuli in the upper-anterior quadrant form a scalene triangle. Centroids of the high-intensity blobs in the lower-anterior region exhibit a near-linear geometric alignment.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, low-intensity, non-patterned 'saddle' region is present on the central dorsal-midsection, providing a distinct visual break in the high-frequency texture.
